reviews.classification: partial actual content review; research, local consequences, historical references and goal-planning scope
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual new review covers original501–1000: micro/macro routing; RV/RQ/RU/RB/RP/RE/SO/LB/TE/TP/RT/RX/RD, TC9–TC15, TGR1–TGR11/G4–G7; KD/RF/KL/UE/EV/LG/KM/BS/IN/EC/TSR/IF/G8–G10; PI1–PI3 opening. B556–B557 cover original1–1000 only. Original1001–2087 and appended notes remain for cumulative coverage. Referenced research/game/source pages are not newly read by association.

F2: Research questions can come from actual anomalies, requests, care, inheritance or curiosity, without a mandated menu draw. Reading/testing may be unattended only under its real clock, support and policy; attention slots derive from actual means. RV6 plateaus do not impose a universal diminishing-return wall on valid practice, and RV8's old one-prestige milestone does not restore the retired gate. Evidence can fail to improve a theory or retain a useful partial result. RU confidence categories remain attributed evidence, not automatic truth or proof that uncertainty always narrows. Source danger acts through its actual exposure/protection; ordinary navigation is not fabricated harm.

F3: Social, living/body, logistics and institutional technologies preserve interesting ordinary lives. A ledger does not guarantee every theft exposed; law does not guarantee predictable justice; a school does not guarantee mastery; courier infrastructure does not prove current price equality. LB6 no-hands/no-lathe shorthand needs actual manipulator/tool/telekinetic/servant alternatives, not a category ban. Strong safety or creation can genuinely improve both capacity and reliability. No automatic hostility, monopoly, suspicion, scarcity, punishment, extinction or ecological tax follows merely from success. Actual people, causes, source support and local policy decide effects.

F4: RT loop/reset and cross-world experiments need their actual carrier, reset scope, RNG/conditions and clock. Equal-looking repetitions are not automatically perfect controlled experiments; source-native random context, independent consequences and changed observer may matter. Loop knowledge is not universally memory-only. A simulator may have an actual oracle/source beyond what its user knows; TC11's actor-knowledge limit is one proposed model, not every cheat's law. Parallel selves may share awareness or merge through real means rather than mandatory disagreement/manual note transfer. Portable constants and laws require source/world scope, not a global science-versus-magic hierarchy.

F5: TGR verified means an attributed October14 web/wiki/excerpt pass, with its own explicit unconfirmed rows. Preserve versions, expansion/profile differences, outdated markers, memory-based puzzle caveat and community status. These are reference ideas, not current product specifications or YAIRPG probabilities/costs. Named percentages, counts, diminishing returns and institutional restrictions do not become universal native defaults. No live game recommendation or external verification was performed here. Old Codex T1–T6 dispatch labels are historical, not resumed workers.

F6: PI1–PI3 propose function/magnitude/form goals and alternative causal planning, not a guarantee every desired outcome is feasible or a mere category permission list. A finite vocabulary is an authoring tool; local mechanisms may supply valid unlisted alternatives. One supported result can share intermediate tools without proving a universal planner or automatic knowledge grant. Graph size, civilization, generations and institution requirements are illustrative ordinary routes; extraordinary source means may genuinely replace them. No new planner, recipe, target implementation, source acquisition, private-save operation, runtime/build/browser, worker, deletion, commit or push occurs.
reviews.evidence: Actual original501–1000 read sequentially in five bounded untruncated outputs. Earlier actual1–500 in B556; no linked-leaf/source credit.
reviews.reopen: Continue original1001–2087 and appended notes; verify unchanged prefix and actual range union before full credit.
